label: copy-phase input k (3rd+ recalled position), strongest when the next output is 2
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost entirely (96% of mass) when the fed-back input is k, plus a little on input 2. It never fires during the original phase, at the delimiter, or at recall_idx 0-1, and it peaks at recall_idx 3-4. Magnitude depends on the token being output: the top activations are k followed by output 2 (59% of mass is at out_tok=2), then out k or p. Just (copy & input k) gets 92% recall but only 5% precision, because most k inputs in the copy phase stay inactive. Restricting to outputs {2,k,p} gives F1 about 0.55 and mass recall 0.82 on dev. The full gating condition was not found.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: k, 2, p, -, <DEL>, e; least: v, t, d, b) and the token being output, by phase (copy phase: 2, k, p, r; input phase: ; delimiter step: ); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, recall_idx=4, L=4 & t=6.
